prompt: The worker at Riga station says the airport train (to run) every thirty minutes.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол says стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому сдвига времён в придаточном не происходит.

prompt: Has the librarian in Accra told you the main library (to close) at ten?
explanation_ru: Глагол has told стоит в Present Perfect, поэтому время в косвенной речи сохраняется — Present Simple.

prompt: My brother in Seoul says he (to play) basketball for his school on Saturdays.
explanation_ru: После вводного глагола в настоящем времени (says) сдвиг времён не нужен, остаётся Present Simple.

prompt: The farmer tells the vet his sheep (not / to eat) much this week.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол tells стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому для временной ситуации на этой неделе сохраняется Present Continuous.

prompt: In Rome, the clerk tells the new worker our post office (to open) at eight.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол tells стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому расписание передаётся без сдвига — Present Simple.

prompt: At a dog shelter in South Africa, the owner explained that dogs (to sleep) better when a quiet radio plays nearby.
explanation_ru: Речь идёт об общем факте, который остаётся верным всегда (на это указывает и plays), поэтому сдвиг времени не нужен.

prompt: During our trip to Morocco, a café owner told us mint tea (to taste) better when you pour it from high up.
explanation_ru: Это общее правило приготовления чая, и вторая часть (when you pour) стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому сдвиг не требуется.

prompt: When I moved to Dublin, the shopkeeper mentioned that the bakery next door still (to open) at six, so I'm going tomorrow.
explanation_ru: Факт всё ещё актуален сейчас, поэтому предпочтителен Present Simple (opens), но после mentioned грамматически возможен и сдвиг (opened).

prompt: During the match in Manila, the referee reminded two angry players that the clock (not / to start) until the whistle blows.
explanation_ru: Судья напомнил постоянное правило игры, а глагол blows стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому используется Present Simple без сдвига.

prompt: Grandad promised us the beach campsite in Croatia (to be) always quiet in June, yet a loud festival began that very evening.
explanation_ru: Утверждение оказалось неверным и относится к прошлой поездке, поэтому после promised обязателен сдвиг в Past Simple.

prompt: At Kyoto station, the guard claimed the express train usually (to leave) from platform four, though the board showed platform two.
explanation_ru: Слова дежурного противоречили табло и звучат как сомнительное утверждение в прошлом, поэтому нужен сдвиг в Past Simple.

prompt: Near Avebury, a local historian told us the ancient stones (to be) older than the nearby farm and still (to stand) in their original ring, which we can clearly see from the footpath.
explanation_ru: Оба факта остаются верными прямо сейчас, что подтверждается придаточным we can clearly see, поэтому сдвиг времён не используется.

prompt: Elena assured her friend in Auckland that she (to need) a quiet evening for biology revision, although she immediately bought a huge slice of cake and stayed in the noisy café.
explanation_ru: Ситуация полностью относится к прошлому, а её слова тут же разошлись с действиями, поэтому обязателен сдвиг в Past Simple.

prompt: At the space centre in French Guiana, the chief engineer has announced that the old satellite still (to circle) Earth and (to send) back sharp weather pictures without any faults.
explanation_ru: Вводный глагол has announced стоит в Present Perfect и описывает текущее состояние спутника, поэтому оба глагола остаются в Present Simple.

prompt: We walked into a gift shop in Singapore late at night. The owner laughed when I admitted I (to feel) too tired to look around. He brought us two cups of tea. Even on our flight home, my partner still tells people that Singapore shops (to stay) open until midnight.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске описано прошлое чувство после admitted (нужен сдвиг в Past Simple), а во втором вводный глагол tells стоит в настоящем времени (сдвиг не нужен).

prompt: Last month I visited a famous theatre in Buenos Aires. The guide admitted the front door (to break) during a storm the week before, so we went in from the side. However, the theatre website confirms that the hall still (to offer) free afternoon shows on Sundays. It was the highlight of my whole trip.
explanation_ru: Поломка двери произошла ещё до экскурсии (сдвиг в Past Perfect или Past Simple), а глагол confirms стоит в настоящем времени, поэтому во втором пропуске остаётся Present Simple.

prompt: While clearing a cupboard in our Kyiv flat, I found an old wall clock. Mum smiled and said it still (to work), so we hung it back in the kitchen. She added that her uncle (to buy) it at a street market forty years earlier. Even my sister admits the quiet ticking (to make) the flat feel warmer.
explanation_ru: Часы идут до сих пор (возможны works и worked), покупка сорок лет назад требует прошедшего времени (had bought / bought), а после admits в настоящем времени сдвиг не нужен (makes).

prompt: Daria sent her parents an email from a floating hotel in Vietnam. In the message, she writes that the hotel (to float) on the bay and guests (to sleep) right above the water. Before the trip, her brother thought she (to hate) staying on a boat. Instead, she didn't want to leave.
explanation_ru: После глагола в настоящем времени writes сдвиг не делается (floats, sleep), а прошлое предположение брата после thought требует сдвига will в would (would hate).

prompt: A food blogger reviewed a tiny noodle shop in southern China. She noted that the owner's uncle still (to make) the noodles fresh each morning before sunrise. In the same review, she mentions that a full bowl (to cost) less than a bus ticket. Earlier, a stranger in the street had told her the kitchen (to close) on Mondays, which turned out to be completely false.
explanation_ru: Актуальный факт после noted допускает makes и made, после настоящего mentions нужно costs, а ложное утверждение прохожего в прошлом требует сдвига closed.

prompt: Two visitors stopped outside an old cinema in Havana that works as a museum. The caretaker explained that the building remains well known because its bright red doors never (to shut) during the day. He also mentioned that a famous director once (to watch) three films from the back row in one evening. Local guides still tell travellers that the entrance hall (to hold) the city's oldest cinema posters.
explanation_ru: Постоянный факт при remains передаётся без сдвига (shut), давний эпизод с режиссёром требует Past Perfect или Past Simple, а после tell в настоящем времени нужно holds.

prompt: Rosa was dusting a large frame in a Lisbon gallery when she spotted something strange. She whispered to the student helper that she (to find) a tiny painted cat hidden under the dark edge of the canvas. The student could not believe it at first. The gallery director happily tells reporters that visitors (to love) looking for the cat, and art experts say the paint (to match) the rest of the picture.
explanation_ru: Находка произошла до слов Розы в прошлом, поэтому нужен Past Perfect (had found), а после настоящих глаголов tells и say сдвиг не применяется (love, matches).

prompt: We arrived at a lively jazz club in New Orleans hoping for a quiet evening. Our waiter apologised and told us the singer (to wait) for the drummer, who was stuck in bridge traffic. He promised the wait would be worth it. As our local host says, live music in this street always (to sound) better after midnight, and nobody ever (to rush) home early.
explanation_ru: Ситуация с ожиданием в клубе осталась в прошлом (сдвиг в Past Continuous — was waiting), а обобщение после says в настоящем времени сохраняет Present Simple (sounds, rushes).

prompt: Inside the planetarium, Lucia said the North Star always ___ in the north.
explanation_ru: Астрономический факт верен всегда, поэтому используется Present Simple (stays). Частая ошибка — автоматически сдвигать глагол в Past Simple (stayed).

prompt: Does the Paris metro worker say the next train ___ in five minutes?
explanation_ru: Вопрос задан в настоящем времени (Does ... say), поэтому время в придаточном не сдвигается. Ошибка — ставить прошедшее left по привычке для косвенной речи.

prompt: Before downloading the study app, check this review: it says the service still ___ free for anyone with a school email.
explanation_ru: После вводного глагола в настоящем времени (says) сдвиг не делается, поэтому нужно is. Частая ошибка — выбирать was автоматически в косвенной речи.

prompt: During last year's interview in Dubai, Omar told the manager he ___ at a small shop, though his hands were shaking.
explanation_ru: Собеседование прошло в прошлом году, поэтому после told нужен сдвиг Present Continuous в Past Continuous (was working). Частая ошибка — оставлять is working без сдвига.

prompt: Minutes before our manager walked into the Barcelona studio without a suitcase, a colleague had whispered that she ___ to Milan for a meeting, which turned out to be a false rumour.
explanation_ru: Слух оказался ложным и относится к прошлому эпизоду, поэтому после had whispered необходим сдвиг в Past Continuous (was flying), а не настоящее время is flying.

prompt: A travel writer says the old bakery in Mexico City still used stone ovens.
answer: A travel writer says the old bakery in Mexico City still uses stone ovens.
accepted_answers: A travel writer says the old bakery in Mexico City still uses stone ovens.
A travel writer says that the old bakery in Mexico City still uses stone ovens.
explanation_ru: Типичная ошибка — сдвигать глагол в прошедшее время (used) после вводного глагола в настоящем (says). Нужно оставить Present Simple: uses.

prompt: Mei tells her friend at the fair she is saving money for a trip.
answer: Mei tells her friend at the fair she is saving money for a trip.
accepted_answers: Mei tells her friend at the fair she is saving money for a trip.
Mei tells her friend at the fair that she is saving money for a trip.
Mei tells her friend at the fair she's saving money for a trip.
Mei tells her friend at the fair that she's saving money for a trip.
explanation_ru: Предложение составлено верно: после вводного глагола в настоящем времени (tells) сдвиг в прошедшее не нужен, поэтому is saving правильно.

prompt: Our teacher in Argentina has told us the school bell rang five minutes early on Fridays so buses leave on time.
answer: Our teacher in Argentina has told us the school bell rings five minutes early on Fridays so buses leave on time.
accepted_answers: Our teacher in Argentina has told us the school bell rings five minutes early on Fridays so buses leave on time.
Our teacher in Argentina has told us that the school bell rings five minutes early on Fridays so buses leave on time.
explanation_ru: После Present Perfect (has told) и для действующего расписания сдвиг не нужен. Ошибка — заменить rings на прошедшее rang.

prompt: Carlos ran straight to the platform and left his lunch on the bench because the ticket seller in Lima shouted the last bus is leaving in ten minutes.
answer: Carlos ran straight to the platform and left his lunch on the bench because the ticket seller in Lima shouted the last bus was leaving in ten minutes.
accepted_answers: Carlos ran straight to the platform and left his lunch on the bench because the ticket seller in Lima shouted the last bus was leaving in ten minutes.
Carlos ran straight to the platform and left his lunch on the bench because the ticket seller in Lima shouted that the last bus was leaving in ten minutes.
explanation_ru: Вся история произошла в прошлом (ran, left, shouted), поэтому отсутствие сдвига (is leaving) — типичная ошибка. Нужно was leaving.

prompt: Marco, a Milan gym instructor, has told members the seven o'clock class never moves on bank holidays. Which report fits?
options: Marco has told members the class stayed at seven on bank holidays.
Marco has told members the class stays at seven on bank holidays.
Marco told members the class did not start at seven on bank holidays.
Marco has told members the class had stayed at seven on bank holidays.
explanation_ru: После has told и для действующего расписания сдвиг времени не делается (stays). Варианты со stayed и had stayed ошибочно сдвигают время, а третий искажает смысл.

prompt: Yesterday in Edinburgh, Freya told a customer the new novel was almost gone, and someone bought the last copy minutes later. How should that customer report it?
options: Freya says the new novel is selling out quickly, so there are still copies on the shelf.
Freya told me the new novel is selling out quickly, though it was completely gone an hour ago.
Freya told me the new novel was selling out quickly, and someone bought the last copy right after.
Freya told me the new novel sells out quickly, because I did not want to buy it.
explanation_ru: Книга уже полностью раскуплена, поэтому факт больше не актуален и требует сдвига в Past Continuous (was selling out). Настоящее время здесь противоречит ситуации.

prompt: A Vienna museum guard says: "The side door stays locked after six." → The guard says …
answer: The guard says the side door stays locked after six.
accepted_answers: The guard says the side door stays locked after six.
The guard says that the side door stays locked after six.
explanation_ru: Поскольку вводный глагол says стоит в настоящем времени, глагол stays не сдвигается в прошедшее время.

prompt: While visiting an Istanbul bank, I heard a clerk say: "The machines check each note for a silver line." → The clerk explained …
answer: The clerk explained that the machines check each note for a silver line.
accepted_answers: The clerk explained that the machines check each note for a silver line.
The clerk explained the machines check each note for a silver line.
The clerk explained that the machines checked each note for a silver line.
The clerk explained the machines checked each note for a silver line.
explanation_ru: Постоянный принцип работы аппаратов остаётся верным, поэтому Present Simple (check) естественнее, но после explained допустим и сдвиг (checked).
